skeleton.label: BloodPressureMeasurement
skeleton.documentation: A schema representing a single blood pressure reading.

children.label: timestamp
children.documentation: The date and time when the measurement was taken.

children.label: systolic
children.documentation: Systolic blood pressure in mmHg (the top number).

children.label: diastolic
children.documentation: Diastolic blood pressure in mmHg (the bottom number).

children.label: pulse
children.documentation: Heart rate in beats per minute (optional).

children.label: bodyPosition
children.documentation: The position of the patient during measurement (optional).
